name: session-harness
description: The interactive coding harness for Claude — one task = one isolated clone + one attended session, plans and code hardened adversarially by the complementary tool, and a human merging every PR.

plugins.name: session-harness
plugins.description: Run each task in its own isolated clone under an attended Claude session: /isession bootstraps, /iharden hardens the plan against an independent Codex critic, /iship implements and loops an adversarial code review to convergence, /reap recycles merged sessions into warm clones.
